hero.title: The Planets
hero.subtitle: In astrology, the planets are celestial ambassadors — each one governs a domain of human experience and colors the area of your chart it touches.

live_sky.heading: Sky Right Now
live_sky.subheading: Current planetary positions · Tropical zodiac · Calculated from VSOP87 series

groups.label: Personal Planets
groups.desc: Move quickly through the zodiac and shape your individual personality, daily habits, and immediate desires. Their sign placements are highly personal.

groups.label: Social Planets
groups.desc: Move more slowly and connect your personal story to the broader social and cultural context of your generation. They govern growth, structure, and collective lessons.

groups.label: Transpersonal Planets
groups.desc: Move so slowly that they define entire generations. Their sign placements are shared by millions — their house placements and aspects make them personal.
